items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: One of the best I ever played with.

ctx.x: He was one of the best I ever heard. I mean, just for a plain, every-day trombone player, yes, he was one of the best I ever heard in my life. He was fine. And I don't think... Higgy I know didn't have no whole lot of musical education. He was no Juilliard man or anything like that. He was a plain, ordinary musician. But he could play. Hell of an instinct. Yeah, a good man. One of the best I ever played with. Very creative. And easy to get along with. Very easy to get along with. A very nice person.
